item.title: iPhone Duo Gains Apple Pencil Support in iOS 27.2
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo will finally support the USB‑C Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2, unlocking drawing, annotation and scrolling on both screens now.

item.title: Apple Music Gets Liquid‑Inspired Rebrand in iOS 27.2
item.description: Apple Music adopts a liquid‑inspired visual identity, ditching its red hue for monochrome, and launches the look with iOS 27.2 and macOS 27.2 updates.

item.title: iPhone Duo Gets Apple Pencil Support in iOS 27.2
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo will support the Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2, a shift that expands mobile creativity and signals deeper iOS hardware integration.
